formula: Use the causal 10%-or-40% growth-sleeve allocation and review every fundamental holding monthly against a 1.50x current equal-stock-weight cap; transfer excess to the frozen ETF incumbent.
known_limitations: The candidate was selected after observing the historical comparison
Monthly review does not guarantee that a stock remains below the cap between reviews
The growth sleeve remains concentrated in five stocks
Full-holdout CAGR and Sharpe trail the fixed 20% capped control
At 200 bps the full-holdout drawdown reached approximately -27.65%
